steps.instruction: Bring a large pot of water to a boil with 1 teaspoon of ground turmeric.
Stir in 1 pound of dried orzo pasta.
Boil until the orzo is tender to your taste.
Drain the orzo in a colander and rinse briefly with cold water.
Add 1/2 cup of drained capers, 1/2 cup of lemon juice and 1/2 cup of olive oil to a jar.
Add 1/2 teaspoon of salt, 1/4 teaspoon of ground pepper and 1/2 teaspoon of sugar.
Seal the jar and shake well to make the dressing.
Transfer the drained orzo to a large bowl.
Pour the dressing over the orzo and toss well to coat.
Add 1/2 to 1 cup of chopped fresh parsley and 1 cup of julienned sundried tomatoes.
steps.spoken: Add 1/2 to 1 cup of chopped fresh parsley and 1 cup of julienned sundried tomatoes.

steps.instruction: Add 1/2 cup of chopped kalamata olives and 8 ounces of crumbled feta cheese.

steps.spoken: Toss to combine. Serve warm or at room temperature.
